metrics.label: Drink attach rate

dimensions.label: Week
dimensions.description: First day of the week (first_weekday in project.yml)

dimensions.label: Calendar event
dimensions.description: The most telling event of the day (closure, holiday, promotion, other)

dimensions.label: Category
dimensions.description: Category according to today's set of categories (METRICS.md)

dimensions.label: Item-variant
dimensions.description: Adjusted item and today's name of the line's variant (by id), or just the item when the variant has no name, was deleted or is unknown, so that a renamed or dropped variant stays the same item

dimensions.label: Category at sale

dimensions.label: Item at sale

kpi_tree.description: Net sales grow with more orders or a higher order value
Net sales are gross sales minus discounts and refunds
The order value grows with more items per order or a higher price per item
The AOV is the sum of the contributive AOVs of the categories
The AOV is the sum of the contributive AOVs of food, drink and consignment
A category's slice of the AOV grows when it is in more orders (penetration) or when the orders with it spend more on it (category AOV)
Net sales are the sum of the net sales of the categories

forms.description: the last n days, ending on the anchor; also last_n_days(n)
the last n complete weeks, ending on the last day of the week of the anchor (the first weekday is a project setting); also last_n_weeks(n)
the last n complete months; also last_n_months(n)
the whole history, from the first sale

compare.prior: the period of the same length right before the window
compare.last_year: the same dates a year earlier

transforms.name: classify
transforms.description: Add a class column: thresholds on a column (ABC classes), quadrants of two columns against their medians (menu engineering) or the lifecycle of an item (new, rising, steady, fading).

transforms.name: cumulative_share
transforms.description: Add the running share of a fully additive metric, largest rows first.

transforms.name: decompose
transforms.description: Split the change of a KPI over the drivers of one KPI-tree identity, so that the effects add up to the change exactly: log-mean (LMDI) weights for a product, differences for a sum, one row per member for a sum over a dimension (new and gone members whole), and with `depth: 2` each member split once more by the identity's `then`.

transforms.name: fill_domain
transforms.description: Add the missing values of a dimension's domain (bins, all weekdays, the hours between the first and last) as rows with zeros, in the order of the domain.

transforms.name: growth_vs_previous
transforms.description: Add `<metric>_growth`: each bucket over the one before it, per group, as a ratio; for a share or rate (format pct) the difference instead, shown in percentage points.

transforms.name: per_trading_day
transforms.description: Divide the summing metrics by the trading days of each row, which the query counted per time bucket, per weekday (or other calendar value) or for the whole window; the prior values by the prior trading days, and the changes are recomputed.

transforms.name: pivot
transforms.description: Turn two dimensions into a matrix: one row per value of `rows`, one column per value of `columns`, in the order of the result; columns of numbers or days are sorted (the hours of a weekday × hour matrix). Total rows are dropped.

transforms.name: rank
transforms.description: Add a rank column (1 = best) over the regular rows; Other and total rows get no rank.

transforms.name: sort_limit
transforms.description: Sort the rows by a column and keep the first n; `Other` and total rows stay at the end.

transforms.name: suppress_small_n
transforms.description: Blank the metrics of the rows below the sample-size rule, instead of greying them out.

visuals.name: bar_trend
visuals.description: Bars of one metric along time (or along a dimension), with the prior period as ticks, the change against the previous bucket, an optional second metric as a line and the calendar events marked.

visuals.name: dot_plot
visuals.description: One dot per row for a metric (a share or a rate), the prior value as a hollow dot and the dot coloured by its change.

visuals.name: hbar
visuals.description: Horizontal bars of one metric, one per row in the result's order, with the prior value as a tick.

visuals.name: heatmap
visuals.description: A matrix (weekday × hour) as shaded cells: the larger the value, the darker; a change is shaded good or bad by its tone.

visuals.name: insights
visuals.description: The insight sentences of the report or the component, ranked, each with a dot in the colour of its tone.

visuals.name: kpi_card
visuals.description: One metric: its label, the value, the change with the prior value, and a sparkline.

visuals.name: notes_card
visuals.description: A short list of notes, one per row (the anomalies, the closures): a column with an optional column before and after it.

visuals.name: scatter_quadrant
visuals.description: Two metrics as a scatter, split into quadrants where `classify` split them (menu engineering), the points coloured by their class.

visuals.name: stacked_share_bar
visuals.description: One bar split into the shares of the rows (payment types), with a legend of the names, their shares and the detail metrics.

visuals.name: summary_card
visuals.description: A period card: the window, its comparison, up to three metrics with their change and a sparkline.

visuals.name: table
visuals.description: A table: one row per group with bars, deltas, rank and the total row, or one row per metric with its current and prior value and change.

visuals.name: text_line
visuals.description: One line of values: Gross 1,234,000 · discounts 12,000 · refunds 0 IDR.

visuals.name: waterfall
visuals.description: A bridge from the KPI's prior value to its current value through the effect of each driver (or member) of the decomposition.

insight_rules.name: top_drivers
insight_rules.description: The largest drivers of a KPI's change, from `decompose`: one sentence per KPI.

insight_rules.name: movers
insight_rules.description: The groups of a breakdown that moved most against the comparison.

insight_rules.name: best_bucket
insight_rules.description: The latest bucket of a trend is the best one (D19): the highest, or the lowest when down is good. A partial last bucket and buckets without trading days do not count.

insight_rules.name: discount_rate_high
insight_rules.description: A value that crossed a threshold since the comparison period.

insight_rules.name: data_notes
insight_rules.description: The data notes (source `notes`): extraction errors and warnings, failing checks.

insight_rules.name: net_sales_drivers
insight_rules.description: The largest drivers of a KPI's change, from `decompose`: one sentence per KPI.

insight_rules.name: aov_drivers
insight_rules.description: The largest drivers of a KPI's change, from `decompose`: one sentence per KPI.

insight_rules.name: sales_record
insight_rules.description: The latest bucket of a trend is the best one (D19): the highest, or the lowest when down is good. A partial last bucket and buckets without trading days do not count.

insight_rules.name: category_slices
insight_rules.description: A group whose contributive AOV moved, and whether it is in more orders (penetration) or the orders with it spend more on it (category AOV): the LMDI split of the row.

insight_rules.name: top_entries
insight_rules.description: A member of a `top` query that was not in the prior top n, from the `prior_rank` column the compiler adds: new at its rank, with the rank it had before, if it sold at all.

insight_rules.name: item_share
insight_rules.description: The groups of a breakdown that moved most against the comparison.

insight_rules.name: peak_hours
insight_rules.description: The top n members of a distribution (the busiest hours) are not the prior period's, and each newcomer beats the member it replaces by `margin` in both periods.

insight_rules.name: discount_rate_total
insight_rules.description: The total row of a metric moved by at least `min_abs_delta` against the comparison.

insight_rules.name: discount_cost
insight_rules.description: The groups of a breakdown that moved most against the comparison.

insight_rules.name: payment_share
insight_rules.description: The groups of a breakdown that moved most against the comparison.

components.title: Why the average order value moved
components.description: The change of the AOV against the prior period, split exactly into the effect of the items per order and of the average net price per item (AOV = items per order × avg item price, LMDI).
components.hint: {{ meta.window.current.label }}{% if meta.compare_ok %} vs {{ meta.window.compare_label }}{% endif %} · AOV = items per order × avg net price per item

components.title: What moved the AOV
components.description: Insight-only (rules, no visual): the change of the AOV against the prior period, split exactly into the effect of the items per order and of the average net price per item (AOV = items per order × avg item price, LMDI). A card names it with `insights_from`.

components.title: Food and drink attach rates
components.description: Per time bucket: the share of the orders with a drink that also have food, and the share of the orders with food that also have a drink, with the prior period as ticks.
components.hint: Food attach = orders with a drink and food ÷ orders with a drink · drink attach the other way round{% if meta.compare_ok %} · ticks = prior period{% endif %}

components.title: Adjusted categories & contributive AOV
components.description: One row per adjusted category with its share of net sales, penetration, category AOV and contributive AOV, the categories sold only in the prior period, and the total, whose contributive AOV is the AOV.
components.hint: Sorted by net sales · AOV = Σ contributive AOV = Σ penetration × category AOV · a category's share of AOV equals its % of net{% if meta.compare_ok %} · Δ vs prior period{% endif %}

components.title: Order penetration
components.description: The share of orders that contain each adjusted category, highest first, with the prior period as a hollow dot.
components.hint: Share of orders containing the category{% if meta.compare_ok %} · ○ prior period{% endif %}

components.title: Data notes
components.description: Where the data comes from, the extraction's errors and warnings from the run manifest, and the warnings of the data checks.

components.title: Discounts
components.description: Per discount code (and the lines without one): orders, gross sales, discounts and the discount rate, by gross sales.

components.title: Gross, discounts and refunds
components.description: The line under the cover cards: gross sales, discounts and refunds from the first sale to the anchor, which net sales is made of.

components.title: Full history
components.description: The four headline cards of the cover: net sales, orders, average order value and items sold from the first sale to the anchor.

components.title: Key figures
components.description: The period's figures against the prior period: net sales, orders, AOV, items sold, gross sales, discounts, refunds, and the first and last sale.
components.hint: Amounts in IDR · current vs prior period

components.title: Last sale
components.description: The time of the last sale up to the anchor, which says how fresh the data is (the note on the cover of today's report).

components.title: Sales lines
components.description: The cleaned sales lines up to the anchor, one row per line, for the workbook of a report: the columns of the Excel file, without personal data and without the line note. It has no visual, so it belongs in `outputs.xlsx`, not on a page.

components.title: What moved net sales
components.description: Insight-only (rules, no visual): the change of net sales against the prior period, split exactly into the effect of the orders and of the AOV (net sales = orders × AOV, LMDI). A card names it with `insights_from`, so a card of a single number can say what the number is made of.

components.title: Orders by hour
components.description: Orders per trading day in each hour of the day, from the first to the last hour with a sale, with the three busiest hours highlighted.
components.hint: Average per trading day · {{ meta.trading_days }} days · top 3 hours highlighted

components.title: Orders per trading day by weekday and hour
components.description: The average number of orders per trading day in each hour of each weekday: when the café is busy, for staffing. A weekday is divided by its own trading days in the window.
components.hint: Average orders per trading day · {{ meta.window.current.label }}

components.title: Payment types
components.description: The share of net sales per payment type, with the orders and net sales of each; beyond four types the smallest are grouped as "Other".

components.title: Key figures
components.description: The four KPI cards of a period's overview: net sales, orders, average order value and items sold, each with its change, the prior value and a sparkline (by day for a daily window, by 7-day block otherwise).

components.title: Periods
components.description: The three period cards of the cover: net sales and orders of the last 14 days, 6 weeks and 3 months with their change against the prior period, and a sparkline of net sales (by day for the 14 days, by 7-day block otherwise).

components.title: Net sales & orders by {{ meta.grain }}
components.description: Net sales per bucket of the period (days for 14 days, weeks for 6 weeks, months for 3 months) with the prior period as ticks and the change against the previous bucket, and the orders as a line below.
components.hint: IDR · {% if meta.compare_ok %}ticks = prior period, same position{% else %}no prior period available{% endif %}{% if meta.grain != 'day' %} · ▲▼ {{ meta.grain }}-over-{{ meta.grain }} change{% endif %}

components.title: Stock alert
components.description: The stock-tracked item-variants at or below their alert-at quantity, with their stock level and status, as Moka counted them at extraction time: negative first (more sold than counted in), then out of stock, then low.
components.hint: Stock at or below the alert-at quantity · Moka's count at extraction

components.title: Stock status
components.description: How many stock-tracked item-variants are negative, out of stock, low or ok, as Moka counted them at the extraction.
components.hint: Stock-tracked item-variants per status · Moka's count at extraction

components.title: Stock counted at
components.description: When the stock levels were read from Moka: the time of the extraction, which a stock report shows because the stock is a snapshot and the anchor says nothing about its age.

components.title: Top 15 items
components.description: The 15 item-variants with the most net sales in the period, with their category, items sold and share of all net sales.

components.title: The week
components.description: Net sales, orders and average order value of the 7 days ending on the anchor (the week, when the anchor is a Sunday) against the 7 days before: the lines of the weekly caption.

reports.title: Category deep dive
reports.description: One page for each of the five categories with the most net sales in the last 6 weeks: its penetration and category AOV per week, its top items, its orders by hour, and the share of its orders that also have food or a drink (the attach rate with the other group). Built from existing components with slot overrides only (plan 9.5).

reports.title: Stock alert
reports.description: The stock-tracked item-variants at or below their alert-at quantity, as Moka counted them when the data was extracted.

reports.title: Sales report
reports.description: The weekly sales report: the cover with the full history and the three periods, then per period (14 days, 6 weeks, 3 months) the overview, the categories and the items, hours and payments. Sent to the group every Monday at 04:00 for the week that ended on Sunday.
